Skiddo

Grass

Kalos · Generation 6

Skiddo is a Grass-type Mount Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 0.9 m tall and weighs 31 kg. It evolves into Gogoat. Its highest base stat is HP (66), with a base stat total of 350.
